name: Inline Frame
description: Perspective Inline Frame component - embeds external webpages using Chromium instance with security controls
author: GitWay

src.description: Source URL of the webpage to embed (HTTP auto-upgraded to HTTPS)

allowFullScreen.description: Allow embedded webpage to display in fullscreen mode

referrerPolicy.description: Governs what referral information accompanies requests to the embedded page

border.description: Border property for embedded webpage content (overridden by component borderStyle)

notes: Many websites block embedding via x-frame-options HTTP header (DENY or SAMEORIGIN)
Uses Chromium embedded browser for HTTP GET requests
Be aware of browser cache - same filename may not update content
Avoid embedding views with iFrame components (focus stealing, performance impact)
Static content prints via Request Print action
Dynamic content (charts, real-time data) may print incompletely due to loading delays
HTTP URLs automatically upgraded to HTTPS
Content inside iframe can make requests to any domain on internet

referrerPolicies.no-referrer-when-downgrade: Referrer sent for HTTPS, not for HTTP (default)
referrerPolicies.origin-when-cross-origin: Full URL for same-origin, origin only for cross-origin

securityWarnings: Websites may refuse rendering if x-frame-options header is DENY or SAMEORIGIN
Content has access to Chromium browser features
Cache behavior may cause stale content display
